strapiBlog.title: Property of the Week: The Element at Sobha One
strapiBlog.short_description: The Element at Sobha One is an off-plan development by Sobha Realty, set in the prime location of Ras Al Khor, Dubai.

data.text:
The Element at Sobha One is an off-plan development by Sobha Realty, set in the prime location of Ras Al Khor, Dubai. This highly anticipated residential project blends contemporary elegance with natural serenity, offering residents breathtaking views of the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, the Dubai skyline, and a world-class golf course. Combining sophisticated interiors with world-class amenities, The Element at Sobha One promises an unparalleled living experience in one of Dubai’s most desirable communities.

About The Element by Sobha Realty

Location

The Element is strategically located in Ras Al Khor, along Ras Al Khor Road (E44). This prime location ensures excellent connectivity to key destinations in Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport. Proximity to major highways facilitates seamless travel, making it an ideal choice for professionals and families alike. Additionally, it is near the prestigious Sobha Hartland community, further enhancing its appeal as a sought-after residential address.

Properties

The Element at Sobha One offers a diverse range of well-designed apartments that cater to different lifestyle needs. The residences are thoughtfully crafted to maximize living space, with contemporary layouts, open-plan living areas, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that allow for ample natural light and breathtaking views. Select units feature balconies, staff quarters, and dedicated office spaces, ensuring a versatile and luxurious living experience. Designed with high-end finishes and modern aesthetics, these apartments reflect Sobha Realty’s signature craftsmanship, creating an exceptional standard of living.

Pricing and Payment Plan

The Element at Sobha One offers a competitive pricing structure, making it an attractive investment opportunity. The starting price is AED 1.82 million, with a 60/40 payment plan where 60% is payable during the construction phase, and the remaining 40% is due upon completion. The expected handover is in the fourth quarter of 2028, allowing investors ample time for financial planning while securing a high-value property in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

Amenities

The Element at Sobha One is designed to provide a luxurious and well-rounded lifestyle, offering an extensive range of amenities that cater to the well-being and leisure of residents. The development features an infinity sky pool that offers stunning views of the Dubai skyline, creating a perfect retreat for relaxation. Residents can enjoy access to aqua fitness centers, cross-fit zones, and an outdoor gym, ensuring multiple options for maintaining an active lifestyle. Business lounges and co-working spaces are available for professionals who seek a productive work environment within the comfort of their community. 

Outdoor barbecue stations, rooftop lounges, and dedicated dining areas provide the perfect setting for social gatherings, while children’s play areas offer a safe and fun space for families. Additional wellness amenities include a Jacuzzi and spa facilities, allowing residents to indulge in a tranquil and rejuvenating experience. The Element amenities are designed to enhance the everyday living experience through a perfect balance of comfort, leisure, and sophistication.

data.text:
Why Invest in The Element at Sobha One?

Developed by a Renowned Developer

Sobha Realty is one of Dubai’s most respected real estate developers, known for its premium craftsmanship and commitment to quality. Investing in The Element means being part of a highly reputable and trusted real estate portfolio.

Prime Location in a High-Demand Area

Ras Al Khor is a rapidly growing residential and investment hub, with increasing demand for high-end properties. The location’s proximity to Downtown Dubai, major business districts, and Dubai International Airport makes it a highly desirable address.

Excellent Connectivity and Accessibility

With direct access to Ras Al Khor Road (E44) and major highways, residents benefit from seamless travel across Dubai. Public transport options and future infrastructure developments will further enhance connectivity.

Flexible Payment Plan

The 60/40 payment plan provides investors with financial flexibility, ensuring a smooth purchasing process without immediate financial strain.

High Rental Demand and Strong ROI

Luxury apartments in Sobha One are in high demand, with expected strong rental yields. The strategic location, premium amenities, and high-quality finishes make The Element a top choice for both investors and tenants.

The Element at Sobha One presents a unique opportunity to invest in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities. With luxurious residences, world-class amenities, and an exceptional location, it stands out as a premier investment choice in Dubai real estate. For buyers looking for a seamless and convenient investment experience, the experts at Zoya Ventures Real Estate are available to guide you through every step of the process.

About Sobha Realty

Established in 1976, Sobha Realty is a globally recognized real estate developer known for delivering exceptional quality and craftsmanship. With a strong presence in the UAE and international markets, Sobha Realty has built a reputation for creating high-end residential communities that redefine luxury living.

faqs.question: What are the apartment types in The Element at Sobha One?

data.answer: The Element offers a range of well-designed residences, including one to four-bedroom luxury apartments with contemporary layouts and high-end finishes.

faqs.question: What is the starting price for The Element at Sobha One?

data.answer: Prices start from AED 1.82 million, making it an attractive option for both investors and homebuyers.

faqs.question: When is the expected handover for The Element?

data.answer: The Element at Sobha One is expected to be completed in Q4 2028.

faqs.question: What amenities does The Element offer?

data.answer: The project includes a sky infinity pool, outdoor gym, children’s play area, business lounges, barbecue stations, jogging tracks, and wellness facilities such as a spa and Jacuzzi, ensuring a premium living experience.

faqs.question: Why is The Element a good investment?

data.answer: With its prestigious developer, prime location, flexible payment plan, and high rental demand, The Element at Sobha One offers excellent potential for strong ROI and capital appreciation.
